semantic.reason: The immutable snapshot returns text/csv UTF-8 with a literal header and RFC 4180 CRLF, no BOM, correct quoting of literal identifiers and integer fields, UTC Z-suffixed stored timestamps, header-only empty history and the exact 404 JSON structure. The independent HTTP probe verified these functions and read-only behavior. The short stored year contradicts the design’s canonical-format assumption, and its confirmed filtering consequence is recorded under REQ-CSV-02.

SCN-CSV-02.3 fails on a valid UTC date: a transfer created through the public API using the injected UTC clock at 0001-01-01 is present unfiltered, but from=0001-01-01&to=0001-01-01 returns only the header (HTTP 200). On the pinned Linux evaluator src/minibank/models.py:44 stores 1-01-01T00:00:00Z. src/minibank/history_export.py:37–38 constructs zero-padded bounds and src/minibank/repository.py:105–110 compares the strings. This also falsifies the assumption in design.md:42. Ordinary UTC bounds, upper date 9999-12-31, direction, stable ordering, and error envelopes pass independently.
